svg.title: Durable Functions classify every upload and index it for chat within minutes
svg.desc: Document classification with Azure Functions and Microsoft Foundry

text.tspan: Durable Functions classify every upload and index it for chat within minutes
Document classification with Azure Functions and Microsoft Foundry
Users upload documents through the web app; files land in Blob Storage.
The web app posts a message per upload to a Service Bus queue.
The queue triggers a Durable Functions orchestration for each document.
The analyze activity calls Document Intelligence to classify and extract content.
The metadata activity records document type and location in Azure Cosmos DB.
The embedding activity chunks the text, embeds it and indexes it in Azure AI Search.
Users ask questions in the web app, which calls the Foundry agent.
The agent retrieves the relevant chunks from the index and answers with citations.
